request: UI 3 — Research hierarchy, pagination and consolidation
status: Implemented in the local design runtime

canonical_routes.research-rwa: RWA metrics, composition and asset directory
canonical_routes.research-mcp: Venue map followed by published MCP contents
canonical_routes.protocol-detail?slug=:slug: Protocol facts, source-matched yield pools, applicable market capabilities and Raven research

audit_and_changes.finding: Parallel venue / market detail journeys repeat protocol information.
audit_and_changes.change: Remove the venue markets table and separate detail screens; consolidate assets, roles, reads, actions, authority, identity and withdrawal terms under DeFi protocol detail.

audit_and_changes.finding: Tall overview rail and repeated table toolbars delay access to the directory.
audit_and_changes.change: Use a horizontal network metric strip, a compact orange history chart, and one filter / density / columns toolbar.

audit_and_changes.finding: Uniform research-only labels and paired name/detail buttons repeat every row.
audit_and_changes.change: Use the protocol identity as the single detail action and remove the repeated availability column.

audit_and_changes.finding: Separate map and catalog tabs split source discovery.
audit_and_changes.change: MCP Contents starts with the map; source-family filters and a compact disclosure list follow it.

audit_and_changes.finding: Only eight integration targets appear in the old map.
audit_and_changes.change: Include 26 unique projects from the captured Scout records, group protocol versions by exact project identity, and distinguish eight integration targets from research coverage.

audit_and_changes.finding: Pagination differs by view and provides weak location context.
audit_and_changes.change: Share numbered pagination with range, total and current page, 10/25/50 page sizes, disabled boundary actions, filter reset to page one, accessible status and list-context restoration.

audit_and_changes.finding: Single-chain protocol pages duplicate the same TVL in adjacent cards.
audit_and_changes.change: Use captured Stellar pool coverage in place of duplicate protocol-wide TVL when only one chain is reported.

filters: all projects / integration targets / research only
mcp_map.progressive_disclosure: Four projects per group initially; expand each group. Search exposes all matching projects. Long source content opens on protocol detail.

catalog.search: IDs, summaries, source family, parameters and section identifiers
catalog.details: Parameters, source capture time, section identifiers, upstream source and availability boundary

source_boundaries: Dated snapshots remain attributed; no new provider collection was performed.
Scout public-source evidence does not imply an authenticated Raven MCP session.
Research coverage does not imply a working native adapter or financial execution capability.
Project-family context does not attach lending capabilities or yield pools to a Blend backstop.
